text: I shipped my app today. Two hundred views.
Two hundred? My launch ad hit forty thousand by lunch.
His app does half of what mine does.
Beep. People don't share apps. They share stories.
So I show the bug that almost killed it?
Or post a clean demo. Nobody cares about your bugs.
One post tonight. Tomorrow, we count.
Comment A for the demo, or B for the story.
